value.title: A collection of nouns and verbs for a multilingual service flyer translation check agent kit
value.lets_workers: Check each translated service flyer against its English source: every fact present, numbers, dates, times and phone numbers matching exactly, words left in English, and sentences above the reading level. The agent lists questions for a fluent community reviewer, who approves each language; staff decide what gets printed and put up.
human_only: Decide what gets printed and posted.
rules: Use only synthetic, clearly marked test data. Never put a real person's details into the kit, a test case or an output.
Steps marked for a person stay with people. The agent drafts or helps; it never decides about a person and never contacts anyone.
Tools are read-only. Anything that changes records outside the requester's scope is a person's step.

value.title: Multilingual Service Flyer Translation Check Kit
value.category_reason: The agent's whole setup as one noun: its step map and pins to every part.
value.summary: Checks each translated service flyer against its English source for dropped facts, changed numbers, dates and phone numbers, untranslated text and reading level. A fluent community reviewer approves each language, and staff decide what gets printed and posted.
value.goal: Help a community center check translated service flyers against the English source for dropped facts, changed numbers and dates, untranslated text and reading level, while a fluent community reviewer approves each language and staff decide what gets printed and posted.
value.target_org: Community health and services center printing flyers in five languages

step_map.title: Compare facts across the source and each translation
step_map.guidance: List every fact in the English source, such as the service, hours, dates, address line, phone number, cost and who can use it, and check that each appears unchanged in each translation. Numbers, dates and phone numbers must match exactly.

step_map.title: Draft questions for the fluent reviewer
step_map.guidance: For each language, list the sentences where meaning may have shifted, words left in English and sentences above the target reading level, as questions for the fluent reviewer, not corrections.

step_map.title: Approve each translation (fluent community reviewer)
step_map.guidance: A fluent speaker from the community reads the whole flyer, answers the questions and approves or corrects the translation. Machine checks never replace this step.

step_map.title: Decide what gets printed and posted
step_map.guidance: Staff print and post only translations the fluent reviewer approved, and keep each approval with its flyer version.

value.title: Skill: check a translated flyer against its source
value.name: flyer-fact-checker
value.description: Compares a translated flyer with its English source for dropped or changed facts, exact numbers and dates, and untranslated text.
value.instructions: Work from the English source and the translation the center provides. Build a fact list from the source: service name, days, hours, dates, address line, phone number, cost and who can use the service. For each translation, mark each fact as matching, changed or missing; numbers, dates, times and phone numbers must match character for character after normal formatting for that language. List words left in English. Turn every problem into a question for the fluent reviewer. Never rewrite the translation yourself and never call a translation approved.
refuses: Rewriting a flyer in another language for printing
Printing, posting or sharing a flyer
Guessing a fact the source does not state
